note: Frost died in 1963, so these books remain under copyright in life-plus-seventy countries until 2034. Fine for a personal daily poem in the United States.
voice: Plain speech with something under it. Walls, woods, snow, roads, farm work, a neighbor talking. Iambic in the ear, conversational on the page. The feeling is never announced; a fact stands in for it. Let one line carry a quiet second meaning and close on a thing seen.
